definitions.explanation: A person responsible for keeping records, taking minutes, or handling correspondence in an organization, committee, or political body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書記|しょき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: To serve as the recording secretary for the meeting.

examples.japanese: {書記|しょき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{議事録|ぎじろく}→議事録：07482_gijiroku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}した→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧。
⟦{生徒会|せいとかい}→生徒会：05378_seitokai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書記|しょき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立候補|りっこうほ}→立候補：13778_rikkouho⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I ran for secretary of the student council and was elected.

notes:
USAGE:
{書記|しょき} is used in various organizational contexts:
- School: ⟦{生徒会|せいとかい}→生徒会：05378_seitokai⟧{書記|しょき} (student council secretary)
- Political: {書記長|しょきちょう} (secretary-general, as in a political party)
- Organizational: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書記|しょき} (meeting secretary/minute-taker)
In political contexts, {書記長|しょきちょう} (secretary-general) is a high-ranking position, notably used for the leader of communist parties ({共産党|きょうさんとう}{書記長|しょきちょう}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書記|しょき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as secretary
- {書記長|しょきちょう}: secretary-general
- {書記|しょき}{官|かん}: clerk (government/court)
- ⟦{議事録|ぎじろく}→議事録：07482_gijiroku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書記|しょき}: minutes secretary
